description: Run the official Chroma vector DB (pinned image) in Docker bound to loopback 127.0.0.1:8001 (container port 8000), data in the Docker volume "chroma". Reach it from RAG apps at http://127.0.0.1:8001.

steps.description: Start the Chroma container (chromadb/chroma:1.0.0) bound to loopback 127.0.0.1:8001.
steps.run: docker rm -f chroma 2>/dev/null || true; docker run -d --name chroma --restart unless-stopped -p 127.0.0.1:8001:8000 -v chroma:/data chromadb/chroma:1.0.0

steps.description: Wait for Chroma to answer its heartbeat.
steps.run: for i in $(seq 1 40); do { curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:8001/api/v2/heartbeat >/dev/null 2>&1 || curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:8001/api/v1/heartbeat >/dev/null 2>&1; } && exit 0; sleep 1; done; echo "Chroma still starting."

uninstall.description: Stop and remove the Chroma container and its data volume.
uninstall.run: docker rm -f chroma 2>/dev/null || true; docker volume rm chroma 2>/dev/null || true
